subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Is the reporter's latest release/screenshot evidence enough to authorize a fix path now, or should maintainers require a live current-main Docker repro that separates scheduled heartbeat routing from the untargeted `system event --mode now` path?
rationale: The issue is credible and user-facing, but current source already preserves the obvious scheduled agent path while docs explain part of the manual repro as main-session behavior; automation should not pick a code fix before the failing entry path is isolated.

options.title: Require live current-main repro
options.body: Reproduce the two-agent Docker setup on current main, verify whether scheduled heartbeat or only the untargeted manual wake routes to main, then choose the narrow fix.

options.title: Queue a fix from reporter evidence
options.body: Treat the latest release screenshot and comments as sufficient and authorize implementation, accepting the risk of patching the wrong entry path.

options.title: Fold into broader heartbeat contamination
options.body: Move this under the broader heartbeat contamination tracker, preserving the specific workspace evidence there but losing this issue as the exact routing target.

recommendation.title: Require live current-main repro
recommendation.body: Reproduce the two-agent Docker setup on current main, verify whether scheduled heartbeat or only the untargeted manual wake routes to main, then choose the narrow fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across heartbeat runner, per-agent heartbeat configuration, docs, and session-routing behavior.
